description.en:
Connect X with the official xurl MCP bridge and native account authorization.

1. Create an app at [X Developer Portal](https://developer.x.com/) and enable OAuth 2.0 user authentication. Choose the app permissions you need. Native App (public client) is the default connection type.
2. Register `http://localhost:8080/callback` as the callback URL. Obtain your Client ID. A Native App does not need a Client Secret.
3. Install and enable X. Open Accounts and authorization. Keep Native App (no Client Secret) selected and authorize; first connection asks only for the Client ID. If your developer app is a Web App / confidential client, select that authorization method instead; only this method asks for a Client Secret. Saved application credentials are reused on later connections.
4. Open the authorization link in your browser, sign in to X and approve access. Paste the complete redirect URL back into the panel, even if its localhost page cannot open. Submit it immediately: X authorization codes expire after 30 seconds.

xurl saves the application settings and account tokens in your Host and refreshes tokens natively. Subsequent authorization reuses the application configuration. Disconnect removes only the active account token. X API usage is billed to your developer application/account; review its access, credits and spending limit.

Upstream guide: [xurl authentication](https://github.com/xdevplatform/xurl#authentication)

description.zh-CN:
通过官方 xurl MCP 桥连接 X，使用原生账号授权。

1. 在 [X Developer Portal](https://developer.x.com/) 创建应用，启用 OAuth 2.0 用户认证并选择需要的应用权限，默认采用 Native App（公共客户端）连接。
2. 登记回调地址 `http://localhost:8080/callback`，获取 Client ID。Native App 无需 Client Secret。
3. 安装并启用 X，打开「账号与授权」，保留默认的「Native App（无需 Client Secret）」并发起授权，首次连接只需填写 Client ID。如果开发者应用属于 Web App／机密客户端，改选对应授权方式，才会要求填写 Client Secret；后续连接复用已保存的应用凭证。
4. 在自己的浏览器中打开授权链接，登录 X 并同意权限。将完整回跳地址粘贴回面板，即使 localhost 页面打不开。请立即提交，X 授权码只有 30 秒有效。

xurl 在你的 Host 中原生保存应用配置与账号令牌，并刷新令牌；后续授权复用应用配置。退出授权只移除当前账号令牌。X API 调用由你自己的开发者应用/账户计费，请核对访问权限、额度与消费限额。

上游指引：[xurl authentication](https://github.com/xdevplatform/xurl#authentication)
